hypotheses.bars: closed 15m; execution no earlier than next 1m open
hypotheses.regime: 4h close above rising EMA200 (slope over prior 8 4h-bars > 0) for LONG, mirrored for SHORT; confirmed by 1h ADX(14) >= 20, both reindexed from fully-closed higher-timeframe bars only
hypotheses.structure: order block = the last opposing-color 15m candle before a displacement that (a) reaches >=1.5x that candle's ATR within 3 bars and (b) coincides with 3-bar peak volume >= 1.2x the trailing-20-bar average volume ending before the candle. Confirmed 3 bars after formation. Zone [open,close] of that candle tracked as active for up to 32 bars (8h); consumed ('first mitigation') on its first touch regardless of outcome.
hypotheses.trigger: first touch of an active zone (price re-enters the range and closes back inside it) while regime holds, PLUS OBV must still be on the trend side of its own EMA(9) at the touch bar
hypotheses.risk: stop = zone boundary opposite the trend direction, minus/plus 0.15 ATR buffer; actual-fill stop width clamped 0.50-3.00 ATR (wider cap than S16: OB body width scales with displacement magnitude)
hypotheses.exit: identical to S16: breakeven-then-chandelier trailing activated at +1.0R, trail at best-price minus 1.5x ATR (ATR frozen at entry); 5.0R hard cap; 240 minute time stop

hypotheses.trigger: identical to H1, PLUS: a bullish (long) / bearish (short) RSI-price divergence pivot (backend/l1_filter/scalp_strategy.py::divergence_events, already used and tested by S7) must have fired within the touch bar or either of the previous two bars

execution_intentionally_identical_to_s16: so any performance delta is attributable to entry quality (order block vs raw RSI/CRSI extreme), not to a different risk model

symbols.note: No BTC reference series is used; regime, structure and flow are computed entirely from each traded symbol's own price.

promotion_gates.development_to_validation: PF >1.05, net PnL >0, at least 40 fills
promotion_gates.validation_to_retrospective_evaluation: base PF >1.10, stress PF >=1.00, at least 20 base fills, at least 2/3 symbols net positive, no symbol >60% gross profit
promotion_gates.paper_to_live: at least 200 prospective candidates across three full frozen months, PF >=1.25 base and >=1.10 stress, expectancy >=0.10R, 95% session-block bootstrap lower bound >0, max DD <=4%

execution.one_global_position: single global minute event loop with one shared cash balance, pending order and open position across the correlated ETH/SOL/BNB cluster
execution.trailing_mechanics: same cluster_scalp_simulator.execute_cluster breakeven+chandelier trailing added for S16, unchanged here
execution.ambiguous_bar: stop first; no favorable exit on limit fill minute

selection: Exactly H1 and H2 central configurations. No parameter grid over displacement multiple, volume multiple, zone TTL, or ADX threshold. A failing gate stops that route; choose no least-bad winner. Simultaneous candidates use fixed liquidity priority ETH, then SOL, then BNB.
stress_semantics: Stress and severe are deployability replays: higher costs and limit penetration are known before entry, so the reward/cost filter is reapplied and the fill cohort may shrink. A smaller severe loss is not evidence of robustness.
known_limitations: Order block detection is a simplified, purely displacement+volume-based causal approximation; it does not require the displacement to break a confirmed prior swing (unlike analysts.structure.detect_order_blocks_v2), to keep the whole pipeline vectorizable without a live order-book/DB dependency.
ATR used for the chandelier trail is frozen at entry, same simplification as S16.
This is a retrospective diagnostic over previously-unseen (for this specific strategy) but historically-public data; it is not a live paper-forward result.
